counterfactuals.label: 20-Minute Brisk Walk
counterfactuals.mechanism: Biophysical GLUT4 Translocation: Skeletal muscle contraction accelerates peripheral glucose disposal rate Rd(t) via AMPK phosphorylation (onset tau=25m, clearance efficiency=1.00x based on BMI).

counterfactuals.label: Food Sequencing (Fiber & Protein First)
counterfactuals.mechanism: Gastric Emptying Delay: Prolongs absorption time constant tau_gut from 40m to 65m, flattening postprandial peak by ~24 mg/dL and distributing absorption over 2.5 hours.

counterfactuals.label: Reduce Meal Carbs by 35g
counterfactuals.mechanism: Two-Compartment Gut Kinetics (Hovorka): Gut glucose absorption Ra(t) = (D*t/tau^2)*exp(1-t/tau). Cutting 35g reduces peak excursion magnitude by 33.2 mg/dL.

counterfactuals.label: Confirm Metformin (500 mg)
counterfactuals.mechanism: Hepatic EGP Suppression: Downregulates PEPCK/G6Pase gene transcription, reducing endogenous glucose production outflow by 18 mg/dL over forward 2 hours.
